main.description: One grudge: a subject, a note explaining it, and the links that back it up. Written to the signed-in user's own repo — a private-in-spirit but technically public ledger, same as any other atproto record. Editing an entry deletes the old record and creates a new one (this site only has create+delete scope, not update) but keeps the original createdAt. Written and read by grudgebook (https://grudgebook.bisks.net).

subject.description: Who or what the grudge is about — a person, an org, an institution, a situation. Free text, not a resolved atproto identity.

body.description: The note: what happened and why it's still owed.

links.description: Source links documenting the grudge — receipts. Capped at 50 as a sanity bound on one write, not a read limit.

severity.description: How deep it cuts, 1 (mild annoyance) to 5 (blood feud). Flavor, not load-bearing.

tags.description: Freeform tags for filtering, e.g. 'work', 'family', 'internet stranger'.

createdAt.description: When the grudge was first logged, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
